calculators.title: Calculators
calculators.subtitle: Run any calculation yourself — prefilled from your profile, edit anything to explore.
calculators.fillIn: Fill in the values above to see your result.

info.wrist: Circumference — wrap the tape around the narrowest point of the wrist, just below the hand bone.
info.ankle: Circumference — wrap the tape around the narrowest point just above the ankle bone.
info.bmrBodyFat: Optional. With body fat, the more accurate Katch-McArdle formula is used.
info.oneRepMaxExercise: Just a label — the 1RM estimate is the same formula for any lift (weight × reps).
info.strengthPerf: Enter your 1RM directly, or a best set (weight + reps) to estimate it. For bodyweight moves scored by reps, enter reps only.
info.restingHr: Measured seated or lying after a few minutes of rest, ideally in the morning.
info.maxHr: Optional. Leave blank to estimate from age (208 − 0.7 × age).
info.shoulders: Circumference — wrap the tape all the way around both shoulders at their widest point (over the deltoids), arms relaxed at your sides.
info.waistNarrowest: Circumference — wrap the tape around the narrowest point of the waist, relaxed after breathing out. Don't suck in.
info.highHip: Circumference — wrap the tape around the body about 18 cm (7 in) below your natural waist, around the top of the hip bones.
info.chest: Circumference — wrap the tape around the chest at nipple level, under the armpits, arms relaxed, after a normal breath out.
info.bust: Circumference — wrap the tape around the fullest part of the bust, wearing a fitted (non-padded) bra, tape level all the way round.
info.hip: Circumference — wrap the tape around the widest part of the hips and glutes, feet together, tape level.
info.armFlexed: Circumference — flex the biceps hard and wrap the tape around the peak of the upper arm.
info.forearm: Circumference — make a fist, arm straight, and wrap the tape around the widest part of the forearm near the elbow.
info.neck: Circumference — wrap the tape around the neck just below the Adam's apple, sloping slightly down at the front.
info.thigh: Circumference — standing, wrap the tape around the upper thigh at its widest, just below the glutes.
info.calf: Circumference — standing with weight on both feet, wrap the tape around the widest part of the calf.
info.height: Straight line — stand barefoot against a wall and measure from the floor to the top of your head.
info.waistNavy: Circumference — wrap the tape around the waist, level: at the navel for men, at the narrowest point for women. Relaxed, after breathing out.
info.potentialCurrent: Optional. With your current weight and body fat, the result shows how close your lean mass is to the ceiling.
info.lossRate: 0.5–1% of bodyweight a week is sustainable for most people; leaner people should stay near the low end.
info.abdomenArmy: Circumference — level around the waist at the navel, for men and women alike. Relaxed, after breathing out.
info.rpe: Rate of perceived exertion: 10 = nothing left, 9 = one more rep possible, 8 = two more, and so on.

bmi.title: BMI
bmi.desc: Body mass index and its healthy-weight range for your height.

bodyFat.title: Body fat
bodyFat.desc: Estimate body-fat % from tape measurements (Navy) or from BMI + age (Deurenberg).

ffmi.title: FFMI / Lean body mass
ffmi.desc: Your lean body mass — muscle, bone, organs and water — and fat mass, plus the fat-free mass index: how much lean mass you carry for your height.

maxPotential.title: Max muscular potential
maxPotential.desc: Drug-free lean-mass ceiling from your frame (Casey Butt).

bmr.title: BMR / TDEE / macros
bmr.desc: Basal metabolic rate, daily burn, and a macro target for your goal.

oneRepMax.title: One-rep max
oneRepMax.desc: Estimate your 1RM for any lift from a submaximal set (weight × reps), with a rep-load table.

strengthLevel.title: Strength standards
strengthLevel.desc: Rank a lift Beginner → Elite against population standards.

powerlifting.title: Powerlifting score
powerlifting.desc: Wilks, DOTS and IPF GoodLift scores from your total.

symmetry.title: Lift symmetry
symmetry.desc: How balanced your lifts are — spot a lagging movement.

plateRacking.title: Plate racking
plateRacking.desc: Which plates to load on each side to hit a target weight.

vo2max.title: VO₂max & heart rate zones
vo2max.desc: Aerobic fitness estimate from your resting heart rate, plus your max heart rate and five training zones.

resistanceKcal.title: Resistance training burn
resistanceKcal.desc: Calories from the work done — scales with load × reps × sets, not just clock time.

trainingKcal.title: Training calorie burn
trainingKcal.desc: Estimated calories burned for a session (MET-based, from activity + duration).

idealProportions.title: Ideal proportions
idealProportions.desc: Your tape measurements against classic ideal proportions scaled to your wrist — see which body parts lag. Every value is a circumference: wrap the tape around, snug but not compressing. Tap (i) for where to measure.

bodyShape.title: Body shape
bodyShape.desc: Classify your body shape from bust or chest, waist and hips — plus your waist-to-hip ratio. Every value is a circumference: wrap the tape around, snug and level. Tap (i) for where to measure.

calorieDeficit.title: Calorie deficit
calorieDeficit.desc: Daily calories to reach a goal weight at a safe pace, and how many weeks it takes.

idealWeight.title: Ideal weight
idealWeight.desc: Ideal body weight for your height from four classic formulas, next to the healthy BMI range.

waterIntake.title: Water intake
waterIntake.desc: How much to drink a day for your weight, training and climate.

rpe.title: RPE converter
rpe.desc: Turn a set at an RPE into an estimated max and the load for your next set.

warmup.title: Warm-up sets
warmup.desc: A ramp of warm-up sets to your top set, with the plates for each.

trainingVolume.title: Training volume
trainingVolume.desc: Tonnage and weekly hard sets per muscle group for a session.

stepCalories.title: Steps to calories
stepCalories.desc: Calories and distance from a step count, and a daily step goal.
